biography.title: Founder Biography
biography.name: Flédéric Payet
biography.p1: Over the past two decades, I have met countless people in distress in various parts of the world. I come from an intense French island myself, Réunion, full of diversity.
biography.p2: I have been confronted with patients suffering from many diverse health issues, as well as with challenges faced by athletes or elite units. Since then, I have continuously developed new methods to adapt to each individual following much research and experimentation.
biography.p3: The gym has become a kind of preventive and curative hospital for me as I now understand the principles of metabolic synchronization and the natural stimulation of the endocrine system. The results across all types of profiles have been extremely convincing.

what_is_sm.title: What is Metabolic Synchronization?
what_is_sm.subtitle: A unique endocrine and cardiovascular stimulation protocol
what_is_sm.intro: It is a unique protocol designed to naturally stimulate the endocrine system and trigger the release of neurotransmitters using very specific and adaptive heart rates during targeted efforts.
what_is_sm.dopamine: Motivation, mental clarity, and renewed drive.

who_is_concerned.title: Target Audience
who_is_concerned.subtitle: A universal application validated in the field
who_is_concerned.intro: The direct and positive impact of metabolic synchronization on the health of patients and athletes constitutes a major breakthrough, addressing three main profiles:
who_is_concerned.target1_title: 1. People with Health Issues (Minor to Major)
who_is_concerned.target1_desc: Program successfully followed by individuals suffering from severe chronic fatigue, fibromyalgia, migraines, heart problems, hypertension, burnouts, depression, etc.
who_is_concerned.target2_desc: Performance increase and recovery time acceleration before, during, and after exertion — without the use of supplements (legal or not). Used in motorsports, tennis, football, etc.
who_is_concerned.target3_desc: Adapted for special forces operators, tactical units, firefighters, and professionals exposed to extreme physical and psychological demands.

what_sm_does_not_do.title: What Metabolic Synchronization DOES NOT Do
what_sm_does_not_do.subtitle: Intervention framework and medical complementarity
what_sm_does_not_do.main_text: The method has been designed to naturally stimulate the endocrine system, resulting in positive effects on health and performance. It comes in addition to, and not as a replacement for, traditional medical systems.
what_sm_does_not_do.progress_desc: Sessions are rigorously adjusted according to the level, objectives, and constraints of each individual, integrating progressive management of intensity coupled with active recovery.

metabolic_effort.title: Method: 'Metabolic Effort'
metabolic_effort.subtitle: Cardiovascular guidance & body integrity
metabolic_effort.intro: My method combines protocols in which I guide cardiovascular frequencies and heartbeats during exertion in order to optimize nervous and cognitive functions.
metabolic_effort.obj1: Maintain or restore body integrity and ensure its defense.
metabolic_effort.obj2: Promote the repair of tissue lesions.
metabolic_effort.obj3: Stimulate energy expenditure for a clear improvement in body composition.
